claim_ceiling: This audit independently verifies the shortest user-visible capability of the query-map MVP: real/cached OpenCaseLaw input produces source-linked result bundles with clickable map progressive phases (map_ready → complete), all harness checks pass (bundle_nonempty, duplicate_free, source_urls_valid, answer_citations_constrained, counter_classifications_supported, geometry_preserved_after_enrichment, progressive_phases, no_fixture_in_live_claim), zero-cost claims are true (evaluator harness stdlib-only, no network; producer reads from cached envelopes only), and source-validity claims are true (all canonical_urls resolve to mcp.opencaselaw.ch). Counter-authority yield is honestly reported as empty for 2/4 frozen questions (corporate-criminal-liability, business-judgment-rule); this negative result is not hidden. Producer state accurately marks the query-map production pipeline as incomplete (no product code path reads real/cached OpenCaseLaw and emits query-map bundles) and the v63 question as COMPLETE (continue_recommended: false, human_gate_ready: false, machine_gate_ready: false). No 174k science benchmark is run or claimed.
evidence_summary: 1) Bundle producer (evaluation/query_map/bundle_producer.py) reads 24 raw OpenCaseLaw HTTP-200 envelopes from the lane's response cache and builds initial+final query_result_bundle for each of 4 frozen questions. 2) Evaluator harness (evaluation/query_map/harness.py) runs 8 contract checks on each initial/final pair; all 8 pass on all 4 questions. 3) Independent re-run confirmed: bundle_nonempty=True, duplicate_free=True, source_urls_valid=True, answer_citations_constrained=True, counter_classifications_supported=True, geometry_preserved_after_enrichment=True, progressive_phases=True, no_fixture_in_live_claim=True on all questions. 4) Zero-cost verified: producer uses only lane-owned cached envelopes, no live network calls; harness uses only json/hashlib/collections/urllib.parse. 5) Source-validity verified: all canonical_url hostnames = mcp.opencaselaw.ch. 6) Counter-authority yield honestly reported: empty for 2/4 questions, published as NEGATIVE RESULT in counter_authority_yield finding, not claimed as a pass. 7) Producer state (/tmp/lex_team/state/evaluation.json) evidence_refs reference query_map_cached_bundle_benchmark run 39834312064; query-map production pipeline accurately marked incomplete; v63 question COMPLETE with continue_recommended=false. 8) No universal-174k science demanded or run; frozen spec SHA-256 187b0e54b03b326c62d45d8ba48fc78dc88501086761cd91a84c304a7478ba72 re-hashes identically before and after. 9) Frozen marker_rule (norm_token AND limitation_token) selects zero candidates for 2/4 questions; this scaffold integrity is verified by legs 2 and 3 of the benchmark.
